name: rova-app
description: Rova Workflow Builder — visual workflow automation with a node-based editor and plugin integrations

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names app,client,inngest --prefix-colors blue,cyan,magenta "bun run dev:app" "bun run dev:client" "bun run dev:inngest"
scripts.example:library-trigger: sh -c 'INNGEST_BASE_URL=${INNGEST_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8388} APP_PORT=${PORT:-4017} bun run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names app,inngest --prefix-colors blue,magenta "PORT=$APP_PORT INNGEST_BASE_URL=$INNGEST_BASE_URL bun run examples/library-trigger.ts" "if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/inngest ]; then until curl -sSf http://localhost:$APP_PORT/api/inngest >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; DO_NOT_TRACK=1 ./node_modules/.bin/inngest dev --no-discovery -u http://localhost:$APP_PORT/api/inngest -p 8388 --connect-gateway-port 8390 --connect-gateway-grpc-port 50062 --connect-executor-grpc-port 50063 --persist; else echo \"[inngest] inngest-cli is not installed; skipping local Inngest dev server\"; fi"'
scripts.dev:inngest: sh -c 'if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/inngest ]; then until curl -sSf http://localhost:4017/api/inngest >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; DO_NOT_TRACK=1 ./node_modules/.bin/inngest dev --no-discovery -u http://localhost:4017/api/inngest -p 8388 --connect-gateway-port 8390 --connect-gateway-grpc-port 50062 --connect-executor-grpc-port 50063 --persist; else echo "[inngest] inngest-cli is not installed; skipping local Inngest dev server"; fi'
scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run build:client && bun run scripts/copy-migrations.ts
scripts.compile: NODE_ENV=production bun run scripts/build-client.ts && bun run scripts/compile.ts
